decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp multi-sample offset in N/E/U near index 489–492 within the overlapping window [485,664], and (2) a pronounced step-like displacement across all axes at indices 607–611 in the [605,729] window, forming a new platform. Both show ambiguous superposition of rapid change and possible opposing returns, warranting closer inspection.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in N and E components around index 489–492, with U showing a concurrent rise; the pattern suggests a possible abrupt offset or platform-like behavior followed by partial recovery. The change is abrupt and spans several samples, not resolvable as a single edge.

Prominent step-like shift in all three components between indices 607–611: N jumps from ~0.0 to ~1.1, E drops sharply (~-7.3 to -10.0), and U becomes more negative (~-2.1 to -3.9). This appears as a sustained platform after the jump, with no clear return within the window.
